captured_actor.description: His mushroom cloud of beard hair is powdered with all the abrasions of the trash sea: white lime, red iron, gold filament, opalescent shavings of the plastiglomerate. Chrome joints and pieces of scrap crystal are hooked to pockets lining his torso, and one of his bushy eyebrows is perpetually cocked, though whether that's a symptom of an insatiable curiosity or forehead mutation is unknown.

race_description.description: Human humanoid anatomy: one torso, head and back; two arms and hands; a paired-feet group. Physical mutations require their actual body variant.
race_description.description_kind: Source-derived anatomy summary; native Humanoid has no race-wide Description.Short. No occupation or named posture inferred.
